line: 好雨知时节，当春乃发生
line_en: A good rain knows its season; it comes when spring arrives.
title_en: Welcome Rain on a Spring Night

poem_title: 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵
line: 烟花三月下扬州
line_en: In the mist and blossoms of the third month, he goes down to Yangzhou.
title_en: Seeing Meng Haoran off to Guangling from Yellow Crane Tower

line: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟
line_en: In spring I sleep, unaware of dawn, till everywhere I hear the birds singing.

line: 空山不见人，但闻人语响
line_en: In the empty hills no one is seen, yet the voices of people echo.

line: 明月松间照，清泉石上流
line_en: The bright moon shines among the pines; the clear spring flows over the stones.

line: 举头望明月，低头思故乡
line_en: I lift my head to gaze at the bright moon, then lower it, longing for home.

line: 举头望明月，低头思故乡
line_en: I lift my head to gaze at the bright moon, then lower it, longing for home.

line: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜
line_en: Before my bed, the bright moonlight—I take it for frost upon the ground.

line: 日照香炉生紫烟
line_en: Sunlight on Incense Burner Peak kindles a haze of purple.
title_en: Watching the Waterfall at Mount Lu

line: 会当凌绝顶，一览众山小
line_en: One day I shall stand atop the highest peak and see how small all other mountains are.

line: 会当凌绝顶，一览众山小
line_en: One day I shall stand atop the highest peak and see how small all other mountains are.

line: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山
line_en: Plucking chrysanthemums by the eastern hedge, at ease I catch sight of the southern hills.

line: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山
line_en: Plucking chrysanthemums by the eastern hedge, at ease I catch sight of the southern hills.

line: 采菊东篱下，悠然见南山
line_en: Plucking chrysanthemums by the eastern hedge, at ease I catch sight of the southern hills.

line: 明月松间照，清泉石上流
line_en: The bright moon shines among the pines; the clear spring flows over the stones.

line: 明月松间照，清泉石上流
line_en: The bright moon shines among the pines; the clear spring flows over the stones.

line: 明月松间照，清泉石上流
line_en: The bright moon shines among the pines; the clear spring flows over the stones.

line: 孤舟蓑笠翁，独钓寒江雪
line_en: In a lone boat, an old man in straw cape and hat fishes alone in the cold river snow.

line: 千山鸟飞绝，万径人踪灭
line_en: From a thousand hills, bird flights have vanished; on ten thousand paths, all human traces are gone.

line: 绿杨阴里白沙堤
line_en: In the shade of green willows lies the White Sand Embankment.
title_en: A Spring Walk by Qiantang Lake

line: 几处早莺争暖树
line_en: Here and there, early orioles vie for the sun-warmed trees.
title_en: A Spring Walk by Qiantang Lake

line: 谁家新燕啄春泥
line_en: Whose new swallows are these, pecking at the spring mud?
title_en: A Spring Walk by Qiantang Lake

line: 好雨知时节，当春乃发生
line_en: A good rain knows its season; it comes when spring arrives.
title_en: Welcome Rain on a Spring Night

poem_title: 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵
line: 烟花三月下扬州

title_en: Seeing Meng Haoran off to Guangling from Yellow Crane Tower

line: 大风起兮云飞扬
line_en: A great wind rises, and the clouds go scudding.

line: 欲穷千里目，更上一层楼
line_en: To stretch your gaze a thousand li, climb yet one more storey.

line: 欲穷千里目，更上一层楼
line_en: To stretch your gaze a thousand li, climb yet one more storey.

line: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋
line_en: Over the empty hills after fresh rain, the evening air turns to autumn.

line: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋
line_en: Over the empty hills after fresh rain, the evening air turns to autumn.

line: 独坐幽篁里，弹琴复长啸
line_en: Alone I sit in the dark bamboo grove, playing my zither and whistling long.

line: 独坐幽篁里，弹琴复长啸
line_en: Alone I sit in the dark bamboo grove, playing my zither and whistling long.

line: 独坐幽篁里，弹琴复长啸
line_en: Alone I sit in the dark bamboo grove, playing my zither and whistling long.

line: 夜来风雨声，花落知多少
line_en: Through the night came the sound of wind and rain—how many blossoms must have fallen?

line: 春眠不觉晓，处处闻啼鸟
line_en: In spring I sleep, unaware of dawn, till everywhere I hear the birds singing.

line: 月出惊山鸟，时鸣春涧中
line_en: The rising moon startles the mountain birds, who call now and then in the spring ravine.

line: 月出惊山鸟，时鸣春涧中
line_en: The rising moon startles the mountain birds, who call now and then in the spring ravine.

line: 欲将轻骑逐，大雪满弓刀
line_en: About to give chase with light cavalry, we find our bows and blades heaped with snow.

line: 两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天
line_en: Two golden orioles sing in the emerald willows; a line of white egrets rises into the blue sky.

line: 两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天
line_en: Two golden orioles sing in the emerald willows; a line of white egrets rises into the blue sky.

line: 两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天
line_en: Two golden orioles sing in the emerald willows; a line of white egrets rises into the blue sky.

line: 两个黄鹂鸣翠柳，一行白鹭上青天

line: 几处早莺争暖树
line_en: Here and there, early orioles vie for the sun-warmed trees.
title_en: A Spring Walk by Qiantang Lake

line: 燕草如碧丝，秦桑低绿枝
line_en: The grass of Yan is like green silk; the mulberries of Qin bend low their verdant boughs.

line: 燕草如碧丝，秦桑低绿枝
line_en: The grass of Yan is like green silk; the mulberries of Qin bend low their verdant boughs.

line: 荷叶罗裙一色裁
line_en: Lotus leaves and silk skirts are cut from the selfsame hue.

line: 荷叶罗裙一色裁
line_en: Lotus leaves and silk skirts are cut from the selfsame hue.

line: 起舞弄清影，何似在人间
line_en: I rise and dance with my clear shadow—how could this compare to the world of men?

line: 起舞弄清影，何似在人间
line_en: I rise and dance with my clear shadow—how could this compare to the world of men?

line: 我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒
line_en: I long to ride the wind and return, yet fear that in those jade towers and crystal halls, the heights would be too cold to bear.

line: 我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇
line_en: I long to ride the wind and return, yet I fear the jade towers and crystal halls.

line: 我欲乘风归去
line_en: I long to ride the wind and return.

line: 大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物
line_en: The great river flows east, its waves washing away all the gallant heroes of the ages.
title_en: “Niannu Jiao”: Meditation on the Past at Red Cliff

line: 大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物
line_en: The great river flows east, its waves washing away all the gallant heroes of the ages.
title_en: “Niannu Jiao”: Meditation on the Past at Red Cliff

poem_title: 江城子·乙卯正月二十日夜记梦
line: 夜来幽梦忽还乡
line_en: Last night, in a faint dream, I suddenly returned home.

line: 无意苦争春，一任群芳妒
line_en: It has no wish to vie for spring's favor, content to let the other flowers envy it.
title_en: “Bu Suanzi”: Ode to the Plum Blossom

line: 落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色
line_en: The setting clouds and a lone wild duck fly together; the autumn waters blend with the boundless sky in a single color.
title_en: Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng

line: 落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色
line_en: The setting clouds and a lone wild duck fly together; the autumn waters blend with the boundless sky in a single color.
title_en: Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng

line: 玉阶生白露，夜久侵罗袜
line_en: On the jade steps the white dew forms; deep in the night it soaks her silken stockings.

line: 玉阶生白露，夜久侵罗袜
line_en: On the jade steps the white dew forms; deep in the night it soaks her silken stockings.

line: 明月出天山，苍茫云海间
line_en: The bright moon rises over the Heavenly Mountains, amid a vast expanse of cloud and sea.
title_en: The Moon over the Mountain Pass

line: 明月出天山，苍茫云海间
line_en: The bright moon rises over the Heavenly Mountains, amid a vast expanse of cloud and sea.
title_en: The Moon over the Mountain Pass

line: 白云回望合，青霭入看无
line_en: Looking back, the white clouds close behind; the blue mist, seen up close, has vanished.

line: 白云回望合，青霭入看无
line_en: Looking back, the white clouds close behind; the blue mist, seen up close, has vanished.

line: 九曲黄河万里沙，浪淘风簸自天涯
line_en: Through nine bends the Yellow River carries ten thousand li of sand, its waves sifted and winnowed from the edge of the sky.

line: 水光潋滟晴方好，山色空蒙雨亦奇
line_en: The shimmering water is lovely in the sun; the misty mountains are wondrous in the rain.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 水光潋滟晴方好
line_en: The shimmering water is lovely under clear skies.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 山色空蒙雨亦奇
line_en: The mountains, veiled in misty haze, are wondrous even in the rain.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 山色空蒙雨亦奇
line_en: The mountains, veiled in misty haze, are wondrous even in the rain.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 欲把西湖比西子
line_en: If I would liken West Lake to the beauty Xizi.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 淡妆浓抹总相宜
line_en: Whether lightly or richly adorned, she is always lovely.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 淡妆浓抹总相宜
line_en: Whether lightly or richly adorned, she is always lovely.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 淡妆浓抹总相宜
line_en: Whether lightly or richly adorned, she is always lovely.
title_en: Drinking at the Lake, First Sunny then Rainy

line: 梧桐更兼细雨，到黄昏、点点滴滴
line_en: On the wutong trees a fine rain falls; toward dusk it drips, drop by drop.

line: 此情无计可消除
line_en: This longing—there is no way to dispel it.

line: 物是人非事事休，欲语泪先流
line_en: Things remain, but the one is gone; all is ended—I would speak, but tears come first.

line: 余既滋兰之九畹兮，又树蕙之百亩
line_en: I have nurtured nine fields of orchids, and planted a hundred acres of fragrant herbs.

line: 余既滋兰之九畹兮，又树蕙之百亩
line_en: I have nurtured nine fields of orchids, and planted a hundred acres of fragrant herbs.

line: 无边落木萧萧下，不尽长江滚滚来
line_en: Boundless, the falling leaves come rustling down; endless, the Yangtze comes rolling on.

line: 无边落木萧萧下
line_en: Boundless, the falling leaves come rustling down.

line: 无边落木萧萧下
line_en: Boundless, the falling leaves come rustling down.

line: 举杯邀明月，对影成三人
line_en: I raise my cup to invite the bright moon; with my shadow, we become three.

line: 在天愿作比翼鸟，在地愿为连理枝
line_en: In heaven, may we be birds that fly wing to wing; on earth, two branches grown as one.

line: 纷吾既有此内美兮，又重之以修能
line_en: Rich already in inner beauty, I added to it cultivated grace.

line: 凤兮凤兮归故乡
line_en: Phoenix, O phoenix, returning to your homeland.

line: 二十四桥明月夜，玉人何处教吹箫
line_en: On the Twenty-Four Bridges on a moonlit night, where now does the jade-like beauty teach the flute?
title_en: To Judge Han Chuo at Yangzhou

line: 东风不与周郎便，铜雀春深锁二乔
line_en: Had the east wind not favored young Zhou, the Bronze Sparrow Tower would have locked the two Qiao beauties deep in spring.

line: 银烛秋光冷画屏
line_en: A silver candle's autumn glow falls cold upon the painted screen.

line: 洛阳亲友如相问，一片冰心在玉壶
line_en: If friends in Luoyang should ask after me—my heart stays pure as ice in a jade vase.
title_en: Seeing Off Xin Jian at Lotus Tower

line: 一片冰心在玉壶
line_en: A heart pure as ice in a jade vase.
title_en: Seeing Off Xin Jian at Lotus Tower

line: 一片冰心在玉壶
line_en: A heart pure as ice in a jade vase.
title_en: Seeing Off Xin Jian at Lotus Tower

line: 昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路
line_en: Last night the west wind withered the green trees; alone I climbed the high tower and gazed to the world's far edge.

line: 昨夜西风凋碧树
line_en: Last night the west wind withered the green trees.

line: 流水落花春去也，天上人间
line_en: Flowing water, fallen blossoms—spring is gone, as far apart as heaven and the human world.

line: 春花秋月何时了，往事知多少
line_en: Spring blossoms, autumn moon—when will they ever end? How much of the past is already gone?

line: 大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物
line_en: The great river flows east, its waves washing away all the gallant heroes of the ages.
title_en: “Niannu Jiao”: Meditation on the Past at Red Cliff

line: 争渡，争渡，惊起一滩鸥鹭
line_en: Rowing hard, rowing hard—startling a whole shoal of gulls and herons into flight.

line: 争渡，争渡，惊起一滩鸥鹭
line_en: Rowing hard, rowing hard—startling a whole shoal of gulls and herons into flight.

line: 争渡，争渡，惊起一滩鸥鹭
line_en: Rowing hard, rowing hard—startling a whole shoal of gulls and herons into flight.

line: 天门中断楚江开，碧水东流至此回
line_en: Heaven's Gate is cleft where the Chu River breaks through; the jade-green waters flow east, then turn back here.

line: 举杯邀明月，对影成三人
line_en: I raise my cup to invite the bright moon; with my shadow, we become three.

line: 大漠孤烟直，长河落日圆
line_en: Over the vast desert a lone smoke rises straight; above the long river the setting sun is round.
title_en: On a Mission to the Frontier

line: 大漠孤烟直，长河落日圆
line_en: Over the vast desert a lone smoke rises straight; above the long river the setting sun is round.
title_en: On a Mission to the Frontier

line: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟
line_en: May we be blessed with long life, and share the moon's beauty though a thousand li apart.

line: 千里共婵娟
line_en: Though a thousand li apart, we share the same fair moon.

line: 千里共婵娟
